name: Zarb
tagline: The WASL approach — Wide Ass Stop Loss as a risk philosophy — streamed live 4 hours a day all the way to $250K+ in documented prop firm payouts.
summary: Zarb (Zach Arbucci) is a futures prop-firm trader who streams 4 hours of live trading daily on Prop Firm Match TV and has pulled $250K+ in payouts with every decision shown on stream. His model blends liquidity, market structure, and Volume Profile through an ICT x Volume Profile framework, executed on 'base hits' across Apex, Tradeify, Lucid, Top One, Vest and MyFundedPerps accounts. His signature WASL (Wide Ass Stop Loss) rule refuses tight stops: if a trade gets wicked out before it plays out, the stop was the mistake — $64K of payouts came in just two months (Nov 2026).
oneLiner: React to the confirmed liquidity sweep with a wide-ass stop loss on an ICT x Volume Profile framework, take base hits, and farm two payouts per funded account.
keyQuote: WASL isn't a meme — it's a risk philosophy. Stops that are too tight get you wicked out of good trades before they ever play out.
highlights: WASL = Wide Ass Stop Loss — tight stops wicked you out of good trades before they ever play out; size the stop so the trade can breathe.
Base hits over home runs — consistent, disciplined entries beat low-probability big swings; base hits secure the payouts.
React, don't anticipate — his #1 called-out mistake is entering before the liquidity sweep confirms.
Framework: liquidity + market structure + Volume Profile in the ICT x Volume Profile blend — draw on liquidity, FVGs, order blocks, premium/discount.
Payout engine: farm TWO payouts per account across Apex, Tradeify, Lucid, Top One, Vest and MyFundedPerps — $64K in 2 months, $250K+ lifetime, receipts published.
Trade the PM Kill Zone live, 4 hours daily — no highlight reels, every decision and every WASL shown as it happens.
